# The stub census's pinned list: every test the python binding's ABI v2
# conformance leg (scripts/abi-v1/conformance/python.sh) must pass, one per line, as
# scripts/abi-v1/stub_census.py names it (its junit classname, ::, its name).
#
# The census refuses a run in which a test named here did not pass (a dropped
# test: skipped, ignored, failed or gone), and a run in which a test passed that
# no line names (an added or renamed test: the refusal prints the line to add).
# "[linux] " or "[darwin] " before a test: required on that OS only, because it
# runs on that OS only. Keep the lines sorted.
